name: google_sheets-mcp
description: Google Sheets / Drive (builder tools): me, list_items, get_item, create_item, update_item, delete_it

platform_mcp_google_sheets_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_SHEETS_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_google_sheets_client_id.description: OAuth 2.0 client id (Google Cloud console > Credentials) of a project with the Google Sheets API enabled.

platform_mcp_google_sheets_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_SHEETS_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_google_sheets_client_secret.description: The OAuth client's secret, sent in the form body of the refresh_token grant.

platform_mcp_google_sheets_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_SHEETS_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_google_sheets_refresh_token.description: Refresh token from Google's consent flow (offline access) with scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets (or drive.file for files the app created); the runtime mints hourly access tokens from it.

platform_mcp_google_sheets_spreadsheet_i.title: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID
platform_mcp_google_sheets_spreadsheet_i.description: The spreadsheet id (the long id in https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/<id>/edit) that every tool reads and writes.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheet_id}?fields=spreadsheetId,properties.title,sheets.properties: confirms the token can open the configured spreadsheet and lists its sheets (tabs).

tools.name: list_items
tools.description: GET /v4/spreadsheets/{id}/values/{range}: collection is an A1 range such as Sheet1!A1:F200 (default A1:Z1000 of the first sheet); each item is one row, its cell values in `cells` (trailing empty cells omitted). The range bounds the rows; page, limit and query are not used.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: GET /v4/spreadsheets/{id}/values/{range}: item_id is an A1 range (Sheet1!B2:D4); content is the 2-D array of values.

tools.name: create_item
tools.description: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{id}/values/{range}:append?valueInputOption=USER_ENTERED&insertDataOption=INSERT_ROWS with {values: fields.values}: appends rows after the table found in collection (an A1 range, default A1). Pass fields = {"values": [["a", 1], ["b", 2]]}; the returned id is the written range.

tools.name: update_item
tools.description: PUT /v4/spreadsheets/{id}/values/{range}?valueInputOption=USER_ENTERED with {values}: overwrites the A1 range item_id with fields.values (a 2-D array).

tools.name: delete_item
tools.description: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{id}/values/{range}:clear: clears the values (not formatting) of the A1 range item_id; rows are not removed.
